annotations.title: Get bundle prices and buy links

description: Get the price and buy link for each PokerData game bundle: one-time USD price, the pack-by-pack price for comparison, what is in the bundle (stack depths, postflop archives) and the page where it is bought. Pass `game` for one bundle, or omit it for all of them. Read-only; nothing is purchased.

game.description: Optional bundle/game slug to price one bundle, e.g. "nlh-mtt-8max" or "nlh-6max". Omit for every bundle.

name: get_pricing

outputSchema.description: Price and buy link for each game bundle.

bundles.description: Bundles, or the one asked for.

buyUrl.description: Game page where the bundle is bought.

priceCents.description: Price in US cents, as checkout charges it.

singlesPriceCents.description: What the same packs cost bought one at a time, in cents.

error.description: Set when `game` is not a known bundle.

games.description: Valid values for `game`, with an error.

title: Get bundle prices and buy links
